players.product: High-purity nano-grade BaTiO3 (barium titanate) dielectric powder

quarterly_data.quarter: Sakai Chemical Industry annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Results for the fiscal year April 2025 - March 2026 (annual securities report): net sales JPY 81,447 million (-3.5% YoY), operating profit JPY 6,452 million (+5.9%), ordinary profit JPY 6,545 million (+4.2%), net income attributable to owners of parent JPY 2,752 million (-45.1%) after an impairment loss of JPY 2,982 million (JPY 2,962 million in Cosmetic Materials). Electronic Materials segment (high-purity dielectric materials and dielectric powders): sales JPY 11,377 million (+13.6%), operating profit JPY 1,816 million (+21.7%); production (at selling prices) JPY 8,095 million (+11.9%). Management states dielectrics for AI-server and automotive applications were strong, and dielectric materials were strong overall despite a temporary shipment adjustment by a customer, so both sales and profit rose for each. Pigment-grade titanium dioxide was ended in the fiscal year as planned. No single customer accounted for 10% or more of net sales.
quarterly_data.figure: Electronic Materials sales JPY 11,377 million (+13.6%), OP JPY 1,816 million (+21.7%); net sales JPY 81,447 million (-3.5%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Sakai Chemical Industry annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management on Electronic Materials (a growth business): it expects the MLCC market to keep growing on steady automotive demand and the rapid growth of the generative-AI market, despite China's economic slowdown and the impact of rare-earth shortages. In the fiscal year the adoption of its high-end dielectric was decided, lifting dielectric volumes from the second half, and dielectric-material volumes rose in both high-end and mid-end grades. The company aims to grow faster than the market by expanding sales of high-margin high-end products and taking share in mid-end products, while securing stable raw-material supply and continuing price revisions. Mid-term plan 'Transformation BEYOND2030' targets for the year to March 2027: operating profit JPY 9,000 million and ROE 8.0%, against FY2026 actuals of JPY 6,452 million and 3.5%.
quarterly_data.figure: mid-term plan target operating profit JPY 9,000 million (year to March 2027) vs JPY 6,452 million actual

quarterly_data.quarter: Sakai Chemical Industry annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual securities report): group R&D expenses JPY 2,844 million in the fiscal year to March 2026, of which Electronic Materials JPY 451 million. The company developed hydrothermally synthesised barium titanate that achieves fine, highly crystalline particles with uniform size, for high-performance MLCCs used in AI servers and advanced smartphones; it is also developing fine barium calcium titanate with a set calcium ratio and high size uniformity for applications needing higher reliability, and further finer, easily dispersible dielectric materials. Development focuses on dielectrics for high-frequency transmission (low- to high-permittivity materials); the corporate R&D division is also developing low-dielectric materials for 5G / 6G.
